Our three competitors,who were having what was really an early season try-out, finished as follows. 29 H.A.

On a rather warm day, and in a field of close on one hundred starters, Eric Gebbett performed very well to finish in 8th place with a time of 1h.25m.18s. He was well backed up by Eric Bishop in 13th place and Bob Plummer 16th. In the team race we just pipped Mitcham for third place.
